_comment: TOOL = public code, documentation and metrics about the skill.
FIXTURE = synthetic schema examples, generated by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA = real observations and runtime output, versioned only in the PRIVATE companion.
The public tool has no runtime data fallback. Guards enforce classification and fixture reproducibility.
_audited: Shipped escalation code records incident hashes and delivery timestamps. runtime_data.py resolves through the installed fleet_guards package, rejects destinations inside this tool or outside a Git worktree, and checks path containment before dispatch; it starts no Git or gh process and does not check repository visibility at runtime (commit-time hooks enforce PRIVATE publication). Dry runs produce no state; successful deliveries record cooldown state. Runtime data is versioned in the private companion. The reminder bridge uses only the schedule-reminder CLI and checks that each selected absolute database and SQLite sidecar destination stays in the same companion worktree before invocation; nested repository escapes and hard links fail before writes. Operator-maintained per-product incident ledgers are core companion DATA under metrics; the public worktree must not contain that runtime namespace.
_data_home: AUTO_SUPPORT_CONFIG or AUTO_SUPPORT_DATA_DIR points to the PRIVATE versioned companion. There is no public or unversioned runtime fallback.
